answer_1.quote: For image captioning and caption editing, we utilize GPT-4o, known for its strong capabilities in cultural and visual understanding... We experiment with 50 representative traditional Hanfu images from Hanfu-Bench as inputs... The framework first generates descriptive image captions for a given image. The caption is then refined through an editing stage...

answer_4.quote: We recruited five experts from a Hanfu club as human evaluators to assess the quality of the 150 generated images from the three models... Six evaluators—three familiar with Hanfu and three unfamiliar—participate in the evaluation...
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators compare the original image with the generated image and rate them on six predefined dimensions.
